@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Taipei 101 is the most famous l______k in Taipei.
= landmark
~詞義 landmark（n.）地標
~原文 Taipei 101 is the most famous landmark in Taipei.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: My trip to Japan last spring was great because the cherry blossoms there looked s______d!
= splendid
~詞義 splendid（adj.）燦爛的;壯麗的
~原文 My trip to Japan last spring was great because the cherry blossoms there looked splendid!

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The boys were full of m______f and kept whispering and throwing paper balls to one another during class.
= mischief
~詞義 mischief（n.）頑皮
~原文 The boys were full of mischief and kept whispering and throwing paper balls to one another during class.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: These women are protesting for e______y in pay between the sexes.
= equality
~詞義 equality（n.）平等
~原文 These women are protesting for equality in pay between the sexes.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Our teacher reminded us that we should check for g______l errors in our essays before turning them in.
= grammatical
~詞義 grammatical（adj.）文法的
~原文 Our teacher reminded us that we should check for grammatical errors in our essays before turning them in.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Critics gave the movie bad reviews because the ______ was boring and predictable.
A: cord
B: bloom
C: drill
D: plot
= D
~詞義 plot（n.）情節
~原文 Critics gave the movie bad reviews because the plot was boring and predictable.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: This ______ is home to some of the country's most expensive apartments.
A: district
B: extent
C: divorce
D: riddle
= A
~詞義 district（n.）區域
~原文 This district is home to some of the country's most expensive apartments.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Being on time is a ______ that many people lack nowadays.
A: postage
B: virtue
C: copper
D: fossil
= B
~詞義 virtue（n.）美德
~原文 Being on time is a virtue that many people lack nowadays.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: I want to come back to this garden next June because all the cherry trees usually ______ at that time.
A: mislead
B: blossom
C: dodge
D: converse
= B
~詞義 blossom（v.）開花
~原文 I want to come back to this garden next June because all the cherry trees usually blossom at that time.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The teacher let David off the ______ this time, but she warned him that she wouldn't ignore late homework again.
A: stem
B: hook
C: curve
D: arch
= B
~詞義 hook（n.）放某人一馬(let sb. off the hook)
~原文 The teacher let David off the hook this time, but she warned him that she wouldn't ignore late homework again.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: bloom
B: mislead
C: correspond
D: dodge
E: bulletin
F: fleas

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: Sally used to ______ with her pen pal, exchanging long letters about school life and personal dreams.
= C
~詞義 correspond（v.）互通信件
~原文 Sally used to correspond with her pen pal, exchanging long letters about school life and personal dreams.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: Please don't ______ my question. Answer me honestly, and I won't be mad at you.
= D
~詞義 dodge（v.）躲避
~原文 Please don't dodge my question. Answer me honestly, and I won't be mad at you.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Sometimes, there may be ______ in your pet's fur, so you should check regularly.
= F
~詞義 flea（n.）跳蚤
~原文 Sometimes, there may be fleas in your pet's fur, so you should check regularly.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: The cunning salesman tried to ______ the woman into believing that the product was fantastic.
= B
~詞義 mislead（v.）誤導
~原文 The cunning salesman tried to mislead the woman into believing that the product was fantastic.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: If there is any important information, it will be displayed on the ______ board in the front of the classroom.
= E
~詞義 bulletin（n.）公告
~原文 If there is any important information, it will be displayed on the bulletin board in the front of the classroom.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: stingy
B: honeymoon
C: convenience
D: drifted
E: mystery
F: frowned

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: Most of us like the ______ of credit cards for buying things, but they can easily cause us to accidentally spend too much money.
= C
~詞義 convenience（n.）便利
~原文 Most of us like the convenience of credit cards for buying things, but they can easily cause us to accidentally spend too much money.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: The fallen leaves ______ on the river and were carried away.
= D
~詞義 drift（v.）漂流
~原文 The fallen leaves drifted on the river and were carried away.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: Steve and his wife went to Hawaii for their ______.
= B
~詞義 honeymoon（n.）蜜月
~原文 Steve and his wife went to Hawaii for their honeymoon.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: Vivian loved reading ______ novels because solving the hidden clues made her feel clever and excited.
= E
~詞義 mystery（n.）神祕;懸疑
~原文 Vivian loved reading mystery novels because solving the hidden clues made her feel clever and excited.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: Mary ______ at her son because he was making too much noise in the restaurant.
= F
~詞義 frown（v.）皺眉
~原文 Mary frowned at her son because he was making too much noise in the restaurant.
